cmd.ai.mode_chat.desc: Opens the AI assistant on its chat: the conversation with a live preview of the draft beside it.
cmd.ai.mode_build.desc: Opens the AI assistant on Generate: describe a building, check the draft, apply it, then make drawings and files.
cmd.ai.mode_review.desc: Opens the AI assistant on Check: run the model checks, ask about the model, get fixes as drafts.
ai_modes.setup.title: Connect a model to start the AI assistant
ai_modes.setup.privacy: Keys stay in the system's secure store. Nothing is sent until you send a request.
ai_modes.chat.edit_request_tip: Puts the last request back into the input to change and send again; the draft stays until a new one comes.
ai_modes.chat.drawings_prompt: Make a drawing set for this model with the drawing set tool: a sheet per level with its plan.
ai_modes.chat.check_tip: Opens Check and runs the model and code checks.
ai_modes.check.explain_prompt: Explain this check finding in plain words: why it matters and how to fix it. Do not change the model. Finding: {what}. Elements: {els}.
ai_modes.build.brief_hint: A two-storey house of about 150 m² with three bedrooms, an open kitchen and a terrace
ai_modes.build.ex.house: A two-storey house of about 150 m² with three bedrooms, an open kitchen-living room and a terrace
ai_modes.build.ex.section: A nine-storey apartment section with four flats per floor: two one-room, one two-room, one three-room
ai_modes.build.ex.school: A three-storey school for 300 pupils with classrooms along a corridor, a gym and a canteen
ai_modes.build.safe: The project comes as a draft: nothing in the model changes until you apply it.
ai_modes.build.generate_tip: Sends the brief to the model; the building comes back as a draft with a preview.
ai_modes.build.prompt: Draft a building for this brief with the generate_project tool, as one item. Brief: {brief}. Use these spec values: {spec}. Fill the rooms from the brief.
ai_modes.build.fix_prompt: Revise the draft so that the remarks of its checks are resolved; keep everything else as it is.
ai_modes.build.drawings.title: Applied. Next: the drawings
ai_modes.build.drawings.hint: The building is in the model as one undo step. Make the sheets for its levels.
ai_modes.build.files.title: Drawings ready. Next: the files
ai_modes.build.files.hint: Export the files ticked in the brief. Each opens its own save dialog; the .rvt file says what it needs when its module or app is missing.
ai_modes.setup.lead: Connect a model once to chat about this project, generate a building and get fixes for check findings. Every change comes as a draft you see before it touches the model.
ai_modes.setup.1: Ask for walls, rooms, levels or parameters in your own words
ai_modes.setup.2: Describe a building and get levels, walls, openings, rooms and a roof
ai_modes.setup.3: Get each check finding explained, with a fix you apply as one undo step
